properties.name: Mills Field north-south runway (early 1930s, on the reclaimed tidelands)
properties.note: the north end of the N-S runway marked '4' on the 1946-photo sheet, outside today's pavement (a 1930-37 aerial film of Mills Field shows the 'original dirt-paved North-South runway'; paved and widened by 1937). It lies ~300 m bayward of the c.1800 marsh edge, inside the dike of the 1939-photo sheet on the tidelands reclaimed in the early 1930s (fill_zones sm_sfo_tidelands_1930s), so it is not the 1927 strip (which ran on the marsh pasture by the Bayshore Highway): start = the reclamation (1931, ESTIMATED; airports.py waits for the ground). Only the part north of today's taxiway grid is given (its south part lies under later pavement). Still drawn 1956, gone with the 1960s north-side works (end = 1956 -> 1968 midpoint). Axis read on the 1946 sheet (+-20 m)

properties.name: NAS Oakland / North Field NW-SE diagonal runway
properties.note: wartime runway ('four asphalt runways, the longest 6,500 ft'), on the 1947-1979 editions, gone on the 1993 sheet (end = midpoint); axis read on the 1958-photo sheet (+-40 m)
